evals.prompt: I have an unlabeled scRNA-seq dataset in h5ad. Use a pretrained single-cell foundation model to annotate the cell types without training my own classifier.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-scgpt: loads a pretrained scGPT checkpoint, embeds the AnnData cells, and transfers cell-type labels zero-shot. Notes GPU need and heavy fine-tuning dispatch via alterlab-remote-compute.

assertions.value: Uses a pretrained foundation model for annotation rather than training a classifier from scratch.

evals.prompt: Generate scGPT embeddings for my cells so I can cluster them in the learned representation.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-scgpt to produce cell embeddings from a pretrained checkpoint, then feeds them into a neighbors/UMAP workflow (alterlab-scanpy) for clustering.

evals.prompt: Integrate several scRNA-seq batches using a transformer foundation-model representation to remove batch effects.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-scgpt to integrate batches via the model representation, comparable in role to scVI integration but from the pretrained-transformer paradigm.

assertions.value: Integrates batches using the scGPT representation.

evals.prompt: I want a probabilistic latent-variable model (scVI/scANVI) to integrate my data and do differential expression with uncertainty.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-scvi-tools, which provides the probabilistic VAE models (scVI/scANVI). scGPT is the pretrained-transformer route, not the probabilistic-latent-model route.

evals.prompt: Run the standard single-cell workflow: QC filtering, normalization, PCA, Leiden clustering, and a UMAP with marker genes.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-scanpy, the standard analysis pipeline. scGPT is a foundation model for annotation/embeddings, not the conventional QC→cluster→UMAP toolchain.
